title: Oncoclastics: a terminology note
description: Definition note for the term oncoclastics: the application of hazard-exposure-vulnerability-resilience assessment, as developed in disaster-risk reduction, to the fragmentation of cancer-related trajectories, in two senses (biological and care-system). Maps the domains of the Risk Mechanism Theory Index (RMTI) onto both senses and includes a small tested Python module (standard library only) that scores them through the unchanged RMTI core. Research framework: not validated against real outcomes; not a medical device. Apache License 2.0.
notes: Copy this file to .zenodo.json at the root of a repository whose contents are this folder, to archive the note as its own Zenodo record. Add the related identifier for the accompanying manuscript once it has a DOI.
